def factor_retvol_volume_scale(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    past_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change(5)
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol5 = ret.rolling(5, min_periods=5).std()
    vol20 = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std()
    vol_ratio = vol5 / vol20.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    raw_factor = -past_ret * vol_ratio
    avg_vol = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_scale = df_copy["volume"] / avg_vol.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_scale = vol_scale.clip(lower=0.2, upper=5.0)
    factor = raw_factor * vol_scale
    factor = factor.fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_retvol_volume_scale"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_retvol_volume_scale"]
